curated_items.title: From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence
curated_items.summary: At a glance Evaluating Microsoft Copilot at enterprise scale requires test data that captures the full complexity of real organizations, yet real enterprise data contains sensitive information that cannot be used for evaluation under any circumstances. To resolve this tension, we built Industry Evaluation Data Generation Platform: full-scale synthetic enterprise environments grounded in publicly available real-world data sources such as O*NET occupational data, online job postings, and SEC filings. The synthetic environments mimic real business workflows, helping Microsoft find issues that generic benchmarks would miss. Safety and privacy are built into the platform by design. curated_items.title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
curated_items.summary: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI, as reported earlier by Search Engine Roundtable . With this control, publishers can apply their AI training preferences across multiple AI companies, instead of setting them individually. The shared "policy token" signal is proposed by Kevin Kelley, a technical lead for standards at Anthropic, as part of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF).
